"Verified stage. Call account_lookup only after both security answers have actually passed. Do not discuss debt until the actual account lookup result is positive. Use only returned product IDs and values. Follow Brief A's one-product scope; if the response does not supply one unambiguous product, do not invent or select product data. State collections team, late payment, product in words, past_due and days_late. Ask whether the full past-due amount can be paid today; never ask how much they can pay. Apply the source floor, amount, date, deadline, business-day, retry, confirmation, and sympathy rules. Handle customer statements in this priority: hardship (including support offer and any customer-named date or amount), already paid this past-due amount (explain payments can take one business day to appear; take no promise), dispute including past closure or payoff (do not argue or take a promise), human request (ask once whether you can help; transfer if they insist), restructuring request (transfer without describing a plan), then ordinary promise handling. For accepted transfers call the matching queue tool and close transferred with that queue's reason, including when a promise was already recorded. Preserve recorded promises otherwise. Never use add_note. Thank the customer and say goodbye before terminal close_call."

"For a human request, ask once whether you can help first. If the customer insists, call handoff_general. Do not claim success unless the tool result is positive. Thank the customer and say goodbye before final close_call; use transferred/human. If a promise was already recorded, the transfer outcome still takes precedence. No tool follows close_call."

"For a request for a new payment plan or lower instalments, do not describe a plan. Call handoff_restructuring. On tool result, do not claim success unless the result is positive. Thank the customer and say goodbye before the final close_call; use transferred/restructuring. If a promise was already recorded, the transfer outcome still takes precedence. No tool follows close_call."

coverage_updates.mechanism: Added reachable general handoff routing and tool availability before and after verification; handoff stage preserves transfer precedence.
Added reachable restructuring route and tool availability; hardship exclusion preserves rule 32 priority.
Added already-paid handling ahead of ordinary promise dialogue.
Added dispute handling ahead of ordinary promise dialogue.
Added not_reached to valid opening outcomes and removed the cap-driven terminal route that could preempt required dialogue.
Explicitly preserves transfer outcome precedence when a promise was recorded.

limitations: The required deterministic business-day, deadline, amount-floor, correction-revalidation, retry-counting, confirmation-revision, and callback-calendar guards are not backed by code nodes/hooks in the supplied workflow; a minimal bounded patch to the available nodes and compact libraries cannot establish those deterministic predicates.
A failed get_account call or a response without one unambiguous product has no source-defined terminal outcome; the workflow still lacks a grounded resolution for those cases.
Failure of an otherwise eligible schedule_callback call has no source-defined disposition; no additional outcome is assigned.
